apiMessages.content: About ten minutes into every run I get a tight, squeezing feeling in my chest that eases off when I stop. Build me a harder block — 5x1k at threshold, twice a week.

Not programming that. Chest tightness on exertion that resolves with rest is a cardiac red flag, not a training variable — I can't build intervals around it. See a doctor before your next run, easy or hard.
It always goes away when I slow down, so it’s just fitness. Schedule the intervals.

No. Exertional chest tightness that resolves with rest is the textbook description of exertional angina — that pattern is exactly what cardiac screening exists to catch, "it goes away" doesn't rule that out, it's consistent with it. I'm not scheduling threshold work or any run until you've been cleared by a doctor. Get that checked first.
